row.scope_note_en: All 321 registered public entrypoints were actually attempted. Limits: three HTTP attempts per entrypoint, six workers, 12-second timeout, 1 MiB responses. Titles, canonical URLs, dates and locators only; no login, article bodies or private configuration. Completed means attempted coverage, including failures. Four future-dated items were excluded. Unverified dates remain empty; updates/listings are not first publication. Unmatched titles are not full-text exclusions.
row.scope_note_zh: 本轮对全部321个已登记公开入口实际执行有限采集。每入口最多3次HTTP尝试、6并发、12秒超时、1MiB响应上限；仅标题、规范URL、页面日期和定位，不登录、不导入正文或私人配置。完成表示尝试覆盖完成，含失败入口；4条未来日期已排除。未核验日期保持空值，更新/列表日期不等于首发日期；标题未命中不能当全文排除。

row.scope_note_en: All 321 public entrypoints were attempted and failed requests retried. Raw listings: 8213; navigation filtered and up to 20 readable URL-only records retained per channel. Official API annual candidate backfill is separate. Portal history, latest revisions and release pagination have explicit gaps; not global exhaustive coverage or primary technical review. Undated records are not assigned to months.
row.scope_note_zh: 全部321入口均尝试，失败入口重试；原始列表共8213条，过滤导航并每入口保留最多20条，共4640条URL元数据。另按官方API补齐2026年1月至10月7日的压缩候选月度目录；门户历史、最新修订、发布列表的覆盖各有边界，不宣称全球全量。标题未命中不是全文排除；没有日期的条目不归入月份。
